MAJOR ORDER FAILED

The efforts of the Helldivers to support the inspiration and education of our citizens was heartlessly stolen by our enemies. Limited footage of Helldivers defending Freedom was gathered; the decision was made by the studio to instead construct the footage digitally.

The ballooning budget means that proceeds can no longer support the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

dispatches.raw_message: 抓住战略机遇 绝地潜兵已遏制在尼维尔43发生的暴乱，而且为《民主狙击手》拍摄了关键影像资料。同时，关于终结族出现新突变的报告已完成调查；可以证实，这些突变仅为表面变化，完全处于正常的终结族基因表达范围内。 真理部认为，拍摄到的这段影像极具电影质感，足以打动人心。因此，剩余的重要指令需求减少了50%。
dispatches.original:
STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED

Helldivers have contained the outbreak on Nivel 43, securing essential footage for Democratic Sniper. Simultaneously, reports of new Terminid mutations have been investigated; the mutations were determined to be merely superficial changes, well within normal Terminid gene expression. 

The Ministry of Truth has deemed the filmed footage to be of masterfully evocative cinematic quality. As a result, the remaining major order requirements are reduced by 50%.
dispatches.translated:
抓住战略机遇

绝地潜兵已遏制在尼维尔43发生的暴乱，而且为《民主狙击手》拍摄了关键影像资料。同时，关于终结族出现新突变的报告已完成调查；可以证实，这些突变仅为表面变化，完全处于正常的终结族基因表达范围内。

真理部认为，拍摄到的这段影像极具电影质感，足以打动人心。因此，剩余的重要指令需求减少了50%。

dispatches.raw_message: 全新战略机遇 尼维尔43发生了一场终结族暴乱，主谋可能是曾在“痛击异见分子之锤”战役中被击溃的生态法西斯恐怖主义犯罪网络的残余势力。虽然该事件的威胁评估为极低水平，但却是一个拍摄关键镜头的绝佳机会，记录下他们肆意妄为的侵略行径。 绝地潜兵必须协助这次紧迫的正义之举，解放尼维尔43。若能完成拍摄，就能将剩余的重要指令需求减少50%。
dispatches.original:
NEW STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY

A Terminid outbreak has occurred on Nivel 43, likely due to the splintered remnants of the eco-fascistic terrorist network culled in the Counterdissident Hammer campaign. While the threat is assessed as very low, it presents an opportunity to capture vital footage of their wanton aggression. 

Helldivers must aid in this virtuously expedient cause and liberate Nivel 43. Securing the footage will reduce remaining major order requirement by 50%.
dispatches.translated:
全新战略机遇

尼维尔43发生了一场终结族暴乱，主谋可能是曾在“痛击异见分子之锤”战役中被击溃的生态法西斯恐怖主义犯罪网络的残余势力。虽然该事件的威胁评估为极低水平，但却是一个拍摄关键镜头的绝佳机会，记录下他们肆意妄为的侵略行径。

绝地潜兵必须协助这次紧迫的正义之举，解放尼维尔43。若能完成拍摄，就能将剩余的重要指令需求减少50%。

dispatches.raw_message: 新重要指令 真理部正在制作一部名为《民主狙击手》的励志教育片。该电影的收益将用于建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心。 这部电影的大部分内容将来自战场实拍。绝地潜兵奉命击杀300,000,000个Terminids、65,000,000个Illuminates以及50,000,000个Automatons，确保获得足够的高质量录像。
dispatches.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

The Ministry of Truth is producing an inspirational education film called "Democratic Sniper." Proceeds from the film will go towards construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

Much of the film will consist of real battlefield footage. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 300,000,000 Terminids, 65,000,000 Illuminates, and 50,000,000 Automatons in order to ensure the availability of sufficiently high-quality footage.

Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.

dispatches.raw_message: 重要指令已完成 感谢绝地潜兵充满慈善精神的英勇善举，以对敌人的无私讨伐，AIR（反光能者补偿）计划已获得最高级别的资金支持。在近期受到光能者干扰影响的每一座荣耀A级轨道退休设施，都已获得高额补贴，对其呼吸强化系统进行了升级。 区域房地产期货逐步走向完全稳定，而且所有企业债务有所减轻，绝地潜兵昂首告捷。
dispatches.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Thanks to the Helldivers’ philanthropic bravery and altruistic lethality, the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative has been funded to its maximum level. Every revered Class A orbital retirement facility affected by recent Illuminate interference has now received a heavily subsidised upgrade to their respiratory fortification package.

With regional real estate futures fully stabilized and all corporate liabilities mitigated, the Helldivers stand triumphant.
dispatches.translated:
重要指令已完成

感谢绝地潜兵充满慈善精神的英勇善举，以对敌人的无私讨伐，AIR（反光能者补偿）计划已获得最高级别的资金支持。在近期受到光能者干扰影响的每一座荣耀A级轨道退休设施，都已获得高额补贴，对其呼吸强化系统进行了升级。

区域房地产期货逐步走向完全稳定，而且所有企业债务有所减轻，绝地潜兵昂首告捷。

dispatches.raw_message: 控制中心提示 绝地潜兵完成本次战役后，将会永久获得DSS“飞鹰”毒气风暴战术行动的使用权限。 此在控制中心工作并将这项绩效激励误标为战略配备的技术人员，已承诺会与其直系亲属一同参与深化再教育研讨会，彻底理解战术行动与战略配备之间的区别。

CONTROL CENTER ADVISORY

Upon completion of this Campaign, Helldivers will receive permanent access to the DSS Eagle Gas Storm Tactical Action.

The technician responsible for mislabeling this performance incentive as a Stratagem in the Control Center has committed to thoroughly understanding the distinction between a Tactical Action and a Stratagem during an intensive re-education seminar, alongside their immediate family.
